scripts.e2e: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Start-Process -FilePath 'npm.cmd' -ArgumentList 'run','dev','--','--host','127.0.0.1' -PassThru; try { $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(60); while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:4321/' -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; if ((Get-Date) -ge $deadline) { throw 'Frontend did not become ready in time.' }; npm run e2e:test } finally { if ($p -and !$p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } }"
